title: The Picard functor is compatible with base change
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes and let $g:S'\to S$ be a morphism,
with base change $f':X_{S'}\to S'$ of $f$ along
$g$. Then the restriction of the
Picard functor
$\operatorname{Pic}_{X/S}$ to the slice site
$(\mathit{Sch}/S')_{fppf}\subseteq(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ of
[def-pc-fppf-site] is the Picard functor
$\operatorname{Pic}_{X_{S'}/S'}$.

proof.text: For $T\in\mathit{Ob}((\mathit{Sch}/S')_{fppf})$ the base changes agree: $X_T=(X_{S'})_T$ as schemes over $T$, by transitivity of fibre products in [def-pc-base-change]. Therefore the Picard presheaves $T\mapsto\operatorname{Pic}(X_T)$ and $T\mapsto\operatorname{Pic}((X_{S'})_T)$ of [def-pc-picard-presheaf], with their pullback functoriality from [lem-pc-pic-presheaf-functorial], agree on the whole slice. By [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-plus-theorem], on either site the fppf sheafification of a presheaf of sets $\mathcal F$ is canonically $\mathcal F^{++}$, and by [def-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction] the value $\mathcal F^+(T)$ is the colimit of the sets $H^0(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)$ over the coverings $\mathcal U$ of $T$ and their refinements over $\mathrm{id}_T$, so it depends only on the values of $\mathcal F$ on the members of coverings of $T$ and on their fibre products over $T$. By [def-pc-fppf-site] (for $S$ and for $S'$) the fppf coverings of $T$ in the slice are exactly its fppf coverings in $(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$, every member and every fibre product $T_i\times_TT_j$ lies over $S'$ through $T$, and a refinement over $\mathrm{id}_T$ is an $S'$-morphism; so the indexing diagrams coincide and the plus construction of the restricted presheaf is the restriction of the ambient plus construction. Applying this twice, the sheafification of the common restricted presheaf on the slice is the restriction of the ambient sheafification. By [def-pc-picard-functor], these two sheafifications are respectively the restriction of $\operatorname{Pic}_{X/S}$ and the functor $\operatorname{Pic}_{X_{S'}/S'}$. Hence the restriction of $\operatorname{Pic}_{X/S}$ to the slice is $\operatorname{Pic}_{X_{S'}/S'}$.
